title: Weighing goods without slowing the queue
target: How to use the scale in Supermarket Simulator for goods sold by weight, without turning every weighed item into a hold-up at the counter.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A product that is sold by weight
A customer who wants that product

steps.do: Treat the scale as a job of its own and keep the space around it clear.
steps.because: the scale is a system of its own with a manager and a controller (ScaleManager)

steps.do: Scan the barcode when the item has one instead of keying it in by hand.
steps.because: the game has one step for applying a barcode and another for entering a code (ScaleApplyBarcodeTask)

steps.do: Stay with the scale while a customer is waiting on it.
steps.because: the scale has its own step where it waits for the customer (ScaleWaitCustomerTask)

steps.do: Read the scale display rather than guessing what the item comes to.
steps.because: the scale shows the product and its details on a display of its own (ScaleProductDisplay)

steps.do: Learn it on the first weighed item rather than during a rush.
steps.because: the game provides tutorial indicators for the scale (ScaleTutorialIndicatorDisplay)

commonMistakes: Keying in a code when the item has a barcode that could be scanned.
Walking away while the scale is waiting on a customer.
Assuming every product in the shop goes through the scale.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
